experiments.title: One-week demand validation spike for the GeoNerd wedge
experiments.hypothesis: If five target UK accountancy practices are shown a scan-based AI visibility report and asked to commit at a tested price, then at least two will commit at >=£19/mo, because the pain is felt and the report is actionable.
experiments.central_assumption: Owner-partners of 1-20-staff UK accountancy practices will pay at least £19/month for a monthly AI visibility digest after seeing a free scan.
experiments.kill_condition: Zero of five interviewed practices make any concrete commitment at any price, or the dominant reaction is 'interesting but I would not pay' after the iterate week, or interviewed practices already pay for a satisfying incumbent.
experiments.decision_rule: Proceed iff >=2 of 5 practices commit at >=£19/mo AND >=25% of scan completers submit an email AND at least one non-network recruitment channel produces a conversation. Iterate once if exactly 1 commitment, or the chosen price is consistently £9, or email capture works but no conversations happen. Stop after the PoC if 0 of 5 commit.

experiments.title: Willingness-to-pay test for an 'all reasonable steps' evidence tool
experiments.hypothesis: If ten UK employers with 10-100 staff and no dedicated HR system are shown a concrete 'reasonable steps' evidence pack and then asked to commit at £12/month, then at least three will commit, because the 30 October 2026 duty creates a live compliance need that free guidance alone does not operationalise.
experiments.central_assumption: UK SME employers with 10-100 staff and no dedicated HR system will pay at least £12/month for a low-cost 'all reasonable steps' evidence tool rather than rely on free Acas/EHRC templates and the HR software they already have.
experiments.kill_condition: Zero of ten employers make any concrete commitment, or a majority say free Acas/EHRC guidance and existing HR software already suffice, or legal-advice concerns block the proposition.
experiments.decision_rule: Proceed iff >=3 of 10 employers commit at >=£12/mo AND at least one non-network recruitment channel yields >=5 conversations. Iterate once if 1-2 commit or the price settles consistently at <=£8/mo. Stop if 0 of 10 commit or the dominant reaction is that free guidance/HR software is enough.

experiments.title: Direct unpaid outreach channel test for Aucly
experiments.hypothesis: If 20 UK primary-school PTAs outside the founder's network are approached directly with the Furzedown case study and free setup help, then at least 2 will launch a real auction within 30 days at zero paid spend, because the case study is concrete proof from a comparable organisation and the main setup friction is removed.
experiments.central_assumption: UK primary-school PTAs, schools and small charities will launch a real auction through direct, unpaid outreach supported by an existing case study and free setup help.
experiments.kill_condition: Zero of the 20 organisations launch an auction within 30 days and the dominant response is that they already use a satisfactory platform, do not run auctions, or see no benefit - or the founder's time per launch is so high that the channel cannot be repeated without paid help.
experiments.decision_rule: Proceed iff >=2 of 20 contacts launch a real auction within 30 days at zero paid spend. Iterate once if exactly 1 launch, or several serious conversations are blocked by setup effort rather than willingness. Stop if 0 launches. Record as untested if legal/permission constraints block outreach.

experiments.title: Desk capability scan: do providers or platforms already supply per-period BiK data?
experiments.hypothesis: If no more than one benefit provider and no payroll/benefits platform already supplies or ingests machine-readable per-period benefit-in-kind data for employer payroll, then the ingestion/reconciliation seam is genuinely unserved and worth a willingness-to-pay test.
experiments.central_assumption: Benefit providers and payroll/benefits platforms will not supply or absorb per-period benefit-in-kind data for employer payroll, leaving a paying third-party bridge.
experiments.kill_condition: >=3 named benefit providers supply or publicly roadmap machine-readable per-period benefit data to employer payroll at no separate employer fee, OR >=2 payroll/benefits platforms already ingest provider BiK data.
experiments.decision_rule: KILL iff >=3 providers supply/roadmap free per-period benefit data OR >=2 platforms ingest it; PARK (wedge stays unknown, do not advance) iff <=1 provider and no platform do so but vendor roadmaps are silent; ESCALATE to a willingness-to-pay test iff no provider and no platform do so AND a documented payroll-vendor roadmap gap exists.

approval.granted_by: worker (desk-only scan; pre-committed plan, no external contact)

experiments.title: Buyer-wedge test: will lab/PIMS vendors fund EN 18029 conformance before a mandate?
experiments.hypothesis: If EN 18029 conformance and reference-list work is a real implementation cost, then at least two of five named laboratories or PIMS/LIMS vendors will name a currently funded conformance or reference-list need or commit to a paid pilot, because implementers must exchange laboratory data and the standard omits the code lists.
experiments.central_assumption: Veterinary PIMS/LIMS and laboratory software vendors, or laboratories themselves, will fund EN 18029 conformance and reference-list tooling before any mandate requires it.
experiments.kill_condition: Zero of five interviewees name a funded conformance/reference-list need, or the dominant response is that nothing will be done before a mandate, or the desk step shows a shipping vendor conformance/reference-list product that adequately occupies the exact seam for the defined buyer.
experiments.decision_rule: Proceed iff >=2 of 5 interviewees name a currently funded EN 18029/VetXML conformance or reference-list need or commit to a paid pilot at a stated price. Iterate once if exactly 1 does, or several name the need but no budget owner exists. Kill if 0 of 5 do or the dominant response is that no work is needed until a mandate. Record as untested if interviews cannot be arranged.
